0022600201.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-4, riding a four-game winning streak) visit the LA Clippers (1-7, losers of seven straight), who sit 13th in the West while New Orleans is 10th. The teams have yet to meet this season, and the 2025-26 series was split 2-2, with the Pelicans winning the most recent meeting 105-99 in New Orleans on March 19, 2026. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery).
